title: The Akshayapatra
style_lock: Premium high-quality charming painted comic / Amar Chitra mythology; warm cream-saffron-gold hour; refined linework
style_master_ref: mood: cream-saffron-gold comic (do not attach Ep01 Drona figure plate)
frame: Ornate lotus carved wooden frame on every plate

apparatus.note: Not fish apparatus — prop continuity for the vessel only
apparatus.vessel: Golden wide circular ceremonial bowl, two curved side handles, short pedestal foot, lotus petal engraving, soft divine glow. Medium-large size. NEVER a U-ring, bangle, or plain cookpot.

draupadi.face: Young woman, warm brown skin, large dark eyes, soft brows, small bindi
draupadi.hair: Long black wavy hair, simple gold
draupadi.costume: Deep red or rose sari with gold border

krishna.costume: Yellow pitambar dhoti, blue upper cloth or garland, charming comic not photoreal

durvasa.face: Fierce ascetic, intense eyes, grey-white beard

plates.beat_text: In the forest of exile the Pandavas keep a simple camp — and one divine gift that never runs dry by day.
must_show: Premium painted comic Pandava VANA EXILE forest hermitage
Thatch huts, peepal, cooking fire, forest path — NOT Drona/bird training scene
Equal natural scale
Ornate lotus frame
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Pandavas forest exile hermitage camp at golden hour: thatch huts, peepal, hearth, forest path. NO Drona, NO bow-bird training scene. Ornate lotus frame, refined quality.

plates.beat_text: The Akshayapatra: so long as Draupadi has not finished her meal, the vessel feeds every guest.

Premium painted comic quality
Sacred golden Akshayapatra vessel glowing with divine abundance
Draupadi nearby or hands near vessel, food vessels and guests implied or soft
Warm holy light, lotus frame
